Paseo Yugoslavo stands above Plaza Sotomayor on Cerro Alegre in Valparaíso. This urban promenade offers views of the port, ships and buildings of the lower city. Russian-language tour programs also refer to it as the "Yugoslav Corridor".

The terrace is connected to lower Valparaíso by the El Peral funicular. Visitors can also reach it on foot via the stairs beside the lift or from Urriola Street through the Apolo passage. These approaches help explain its place on walking routes through the hills: the terrace links the city streets with an open view of the bay.

Baburizza Palace, home to the Valparaíso Museum of Fine Arts, stands beside Paseo Yugoslavo. The terrace is also a destination in its own right. Taking in the panorama and visiting the museum galleries require different amounts of time and may feature in different tours.
